response.sql: WITH category_totals AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount >= 75 GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM category_totals) SELECT c.category, c.average_remaining, c.total, c.total - o.average_total AS above_overall_average FROM category_totals AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_total IS NOT NULL AND c.total > o.average_total;
